name: Ellora Caves
description: Near Aurangabad in Maharashtra, Ellora is a line of 34 monasteries and temples carved side by side into a basalt cliff over more than 2 km. Buddhist, Hindu and Jain sanctuaries sit as neighbours, made between about AD 600 and 1000. The showstopper is Cave 16, the Kailash temple, a chariot-shaped shrine to Shiva cut from a single mass of rock.
